title: Candidate-family value estimates (Experiment 6, S1 output)
description: Model-mediated predicted-value estimates per candidate topology family, serialized before candidate generation. Cost is NOT estimated here: it is computed deterministically from the family's expected call structure (utility-operationalization.md). Each estimate is a prediction of the observed component as operationalized: delta_e = 0.5*(fraction of unresolved distinctions resolved with admissible evidence) + 0.5*(fraction of evidence records that are novel, i.e. not duplicates of parent-local evidence); redundancy = fraction of evidence records that duplicate parent-local evidence; governance_risk = 0.25 * expected count of formal/governance failures.
